"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"American diplomats must raise the issue wherever harassment or abuse arises.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Obama administration has led the world to recognize and defend Internet freedom - the freedom of expression, assembly, and association online for people everywhere - through coalitions of countries and by empowering individuals with innovative technologies.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The administration successfully negotiated international Internet policymaking principles.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The administration supports the current multi-stakeholder approach to Internet governance.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The administration opposes the extension of intergovernmental controls over the Internet.",
